{{Top|leg}}
The '''quad blaster''' or quad-[[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]], was one of the modified weapons that was found on board the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar's]] personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Punishing One/Legends|''Punishing One'']].<ref name="Payback">{{StoryCite|story=Payback: The Tale of Dengar|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> The [[Hunter-Killer probot]] was equipped with two quad blasters.<ref name="ROB">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=Raid on Brentaal}}</ref>
